observation_summary: The iterator returned by ListPopulation allows modification of the internal chromosome list, failing to throw an UnsupportedOperationException as expected by the test.
reasoning_summary: The ListPopulation class exposes its internal list of chromosomes directly through the iterator() method. This allows external code to modify the internal state of the population (e.g., by calling remove() on the iterator) without going through the class's controlled API. The failing test confirms this by expecting an UnsupportedOperationException when attempting to remove an element, which is not thrown because the underlying list is still mutable.
